title: Concept: Lock file uses the first format, which records less restore detail
description: packages.lock.json declares a `packages.lock.json` on the older lock-file format, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Without a recorded digest the downloaded artifact cannot be checked against what was reviewed, so substitution is undetectable at install time. This rule reads a `packages.lock.json` on the older lock-file format.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through packages.lock.json (nuget).
risk: Without a recorded digest the downloaded artifact cannot be checked against what was reviewed, so substitution is undetectable at install time. This rule reads a `packages.lock.json` on the older lock-file format.
